name: Steady Qi
description: Hold the user's qi to one regular flow so strain and fatigue cannot make it surge or sag.

name: Regular Palm
description: Strike with a flat palm at the end of each breath so the blow carries the user's whole even rhythm.

name: Regular Step
description: Shift the weight onto the front foot in one smooth pace that leaves the user balanced to strike.

name: Statute Ward
description: Hold a plain steady plane of order qi before the chest that blunts blows without any tilt.

name: Calm Current
description: Lay a hand on an ally and straighten their wild qi flow back into its channels to ease a Qi Deviation backlash.

name: Level Surge
description: Release a held measure of qi in a single level pulse through the palm into the target's chest.

name: Necessity Grip
description: Catch the opponent's forearm and fix it with qi so the limb can move only where the user allows.

name: Law Palm
description: Strike with a palm that falls exactly where the guard is weakest as if the blow were already decreed.

name: Binding Guard
description: Hold a guard that clings to a grasping hand and locks it against the user's forearm.

name: Pinion Step
description: Step in a tight half circle round the opponent's trapped arm to come in on the open side.

name: Fixed Wrist
description: Close qi round a wrist so the joint stiffens and the hand can neither grip nor strike.

name: Measured Elbow
description: Drive a short elbow into a held opponent at the exact length needed to rattle the ribs.

name: Lock Chain
description: Chain order qi from one bound limb to the next until both arms and the torso are held in place.

name: Decree Hold
description: Press a palm to the chest and hold the opponent's qi still so no technique can be started.

name: Beat Strike
description: Strike on the beat of a kept rhythm so each blow follows the last without a pause for the foe.

name: Beat Guard
description: Turn aside each blow on its beat so the guard answers in step with the attack.

name: Drumstep
description: Take a hard rhythmic pace that sets the beat for the fight and keeps the user on it.

name: Metered Jab
description: Jab a hardened finger at one point in counted time to open a seam in the guard.

name: Cadence Count
description: Count the pulse and breath of an opponent through the air to learn when it will tire.

name: Unbroken Time
description: Keep the rhythm of the fight unbroken for the user so each strike lands faster and cleaner than before.

name: Rhythm Break
description: Strike the opponent off its own beat so the next three moves come late and stumble.

name: Hushed Palm
description: Strike with a palm inside the calm field so the blow lands without any wasted spread of force.

name: Settling Calm
description: Spread a small calm field round the user in which loose energy drifts down and loses its force.

name: Plumb Pace
description: Move inside the field in short steady paces without ever stepping onto uneven or broken ground.

name: Edge Mark
description: Feel the border of the field so any person or force crossing it is known at once.

name: Stillness Pulse
description: Send a pulse of calm through the field that dulls the sharp edge of a nearby technique.

name: Fixed Calm
description: Fix the field to the ground so it does not drift and shelters the user and one ally together.

name: Lull Wave
description: Send a wave of order outward that dampens every qi technique in a short radius for a breath.

name: Mend Order
description: Straighten the tangled qi of an ally inside the field and clear a taint or a lingering poison.

name: Stillness Burst
description: Release the stored calm of the field at once as a flat shock that shoves back all near the user.

name: Weigh Palm
description: Strike with a palm weighed to match the force that struck first so no more or less is given.

name: Balance Guard
description: Weigh an incoming blow and raise a guard holding exactly that much qi to meet it.

name: Scale Step
description: Rock the weight from one foot to the other like a scale beam and step into the opening.

name: Weighing Eye
description: Judge by sight and touch how much force an opponent holds behind a single blow.

name: Fair Return
description: Send back a glancing blow at nearly the strength it came with by turning the guard to meet it.

name: Heavy Pound
description: Pound a closed fist down on a raised guard with a force set just above what the guard holds.

name: Parity Stance
description: Settle into a stance that draws the user's strength level with the foe's so no gap can open.

name: Answering Weight
description: Meet a heavy blow with its equal in the other hand so it is turned away and answered in one motion.

name: Tilting Beam
description: Tip the opponent's balance against itself with a push timed to the instant it commits its weight.

name: Settled Account
description: Repay a wound taken in the exchange with one thrust of equal depth aimed at the same place.

name: Straight Palm
description: Strike with a palm driven along one dead straight line from the shoulder to the target.

name: Ruled Guard
description: Hold a rigid straight forearm across the line of attack so the blow cannot slip round it.

name: Straight Dash
description: Rush forward along a perfectly straight path that gives the foe no angle to catch.

name: Unbent Needle
description: Thrust qi gathered into a single hard point straight through a guard that has no give.

name: Axis Read
description: Find the central line of an opponent's body and learn where a single blow would do the most harm.

name: Plumb Fall
description: Drop a downward strike from a high guard along the plumb line to break a stance.

name: Piercing Lance
description: Drive a long straight lance of qi from the palm that pierces everything standing along its line.

name: Rigid Bar
description: Set a rigid bar of qi along the line of attack that no blow can bend or break through easily.

name: Mend Form
description: Set the user's own fraying technique back into its proper pattern so it runs clean again.

name: Pattern Palm
description: Strike with a palm laid on the exact pattern of the foe's guard and drive through its gap.

name: Rule Reading
description: Read how an opposing technique is built so the user knows which part will fail first.

name: Orderly Retreat
description: Fall back three paces in strict order with the guard held so no opening appears in the withdrawal.

name: Undo Knot
description: Pick apart the knot of a simple binding technique laid on the user and set the strands free.

name: Restore Form
description: Restore an ally's damaged technique and the qi channels beneath it to working order after a backlash.

name: Unmake Rule
description: Reach into an opposing technique and unpick its pattern so it falls apart before it finishes.
